data.title: Summit Therapeutics and Lunit Announce Agreement to Apply AI-powered SCOPE IO Platform for Tumor Microenvironment Analysis in Immuno-Oncology Development | SMMT Stock News
data.description:
The companies aim to use routine tissue images to explore biomarkers and patient selection for ivonescimab development.

Research Will Use Lunit’s AI-powered Pathology Platform to Analyze H&E Whole-Slide Images and Generate Scalable Insights into Tumor Microenvironment Biology

MIAMI & SEOUL, South Korea--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) and Lunit Inc. (KRX: 328130) today announced a research agreement to evaluate the use of Lunit SCOPE IO, Lunit’s AI-powered pathology platform, for tumor microenvironment analysis in support of Summit’s immuno-oncology development programs with ivonescimab.

The effort will focus on applying Lunit SCOPE IO to hematoxylin and eosin-stained (H&E) whole-slide images to characterize tumor microenvironment features. The companies aim to explore how AI-powered pathology analysis can support biomarker discovery, patient stratification or selection, and a deeper biological understanding of response to ivonescimab therapies.

Summit is developing ivonescimab, a novel, potential first-in-class investigational PD-1 / VEGF bispecific antibody, in several solid tumors. Lunit SCOPE IO is designed to support immuno-oncology research and biomarker development through AI-powered analysis of H&E slides, enabling scalable assessment of tumor microenvironment features without requiring additional stains or assays.

“Understanding the tumor microenvironment is increasingly important as immuno-oncology moves beyond single-axis checkpoint inhibition toward more complex mechanisms and combinations,” said Allen Yang, MD, PhD, Chief Research and Development Strategy Officer of Summit. “We are pleased to work with Lunit to explore how AI-powered pathology can help generate deeper, more scalable insights from routine tissue samples and inform the continued development of ivonescimab.”

“Summit is at the forefront of next-generation immuno-oncology development, and we are excited to support its efforts with Lunit SCOPE IO,” said Brandon Suh, Lunit CEO. “By extracting quantitative, spatially resolved immune and tumor microenvironment features from standard H&E slides, we believe SCOPE IO can help biopharma partners better understand which patients may benefit from immuno-oncology therapies and why.”

This agreement reflects the growing importance of computational pathology in oncology drug development. Routine H&E slides contain rich information about tumor architecture, immune infiltration, stromal organization, and spatial interactions within the tumor microenvironment. However, traditional manual assessment can be difficult to scale and may not fully capture the quantitative and spatial complexity of the tumor-immune interface. AI-powered analysis offers the potential to convert these routinely generated pathology images into reproducible, high-dimensional biomarker data.

The companies expect the work to generate tumor microenvironment insights that may inform future translational research, exploratory biomarker strategies, and clinical development planning. No clinical outcome data are being announced as part of this release.

Lunit SCOPE products are for research use only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures or decisions.

About Ivonescimab

Ivonescimab, known as SMT112 in Summit’s license territories, North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Japan, and as AK112 outside of Summit’s license territories, is a novel, potential first-in-class investigational bispecific antibody combining the effects of immunotherapy via a blockade of PD-1 with the anti-angiogenesis effects associated with blocking VEGF into a single molecule. By design, ivonescimab displays unique cooperative binding to each of its intended targets with multifold higher affinity to PD-1 when in the presence of VEGF.

This design is intended to differentiate ivonescimab as there is potentially higher expression (presence) of both PD-1 and VEGF in tumor tissue and the tumor microenvironment (TME) as compared to normal tissue in the body. Summit believes ivonescimab’s specifically engineered tetravalent structure (four binding sites) enables higher avidity (accumulated strength of multiple binding interactions) in the TME (Zhong, et al, iScience, 2025). This tetravalent structure, the intentional novel design of the molecule, and bringing these two targets into a single bispecific antibody with cooperative binding qualities have the potential to direct ivonescimab to the tumor tissue versus healthy tissue. The intent of ivonescimab’s design, together with a half-life of 6 to 7 days after the first dose (Zhong, et al, iScience, 2025) increasing to approximately 10 days at steady state dosing, is to improve upon previously established efficacy thresholds, side effects, and safety profiles associated with prior approved drugs to these targets.

Ivonescimab was invented by Akeso Inc. (HKEX Code: 9926.HK) and is currently utilized in multiple Phase III clinical trials. Over 5,000 patients have been treated with ivonescimab in clinical studies globally and over 100,000 patients when considering those treated in a commercial setting in China, as noted by Akeso.

There are currently 17 Phase III clinical studies that are either announced, ongoing, or have been completed studying ivonescimab, five of which are Summit-sponsored global studies, two of which are studies sponsored by cooperative groups, and 10 of which are being or have been conducted in China by Akeso. Summit began its clinical development of ivonescimab in NSCLC (HARMONi, HARMONi-3, HARMONi-7) and expanded its sponsored Phase III clinical development program into colorectal cancer (CRC; HARMONi-GI3) and urothelial carcinoma (bladder cancer; HARMONi-GU1). The two cooperative studies are in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC; ILLUMINE) and biliary tract cancer (BTC; EA2251).

Five Phase III ivonescimab clinical trials have read out to date, all five with positive data. Four of these five studies are in NSCLC and one is in BTC. In addition to Summit’s positive HARMONi study in NSCLC, Akeso has had positive read-outs in four single-region (China), randomized Phase III clinical trials, HARMONi-A, HARMONi-2, HARMONi-6 (each in NSCLC), and HARMONi-GI1 (in BTC) for ivonescimab, including a statistically significant overall survival benefit in all four studies from China.

Akeso is actively conducting additional Phase III clinical studies in settings outside of NSCLC and biliary-tract cancer, including triple-negative breast cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, and pancreatic cancer.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy that is not approved by any regulatory authority in Summit’s license territories, including the United States and Europe. Ivonescimab was initially approved for marketing authorization in China in May 2024.

About Lunit Inc.

Founded in 2013, Lunit (KRX: 328130) is a global leader on a mission to conquer cancer through AI. Our clinically validated solutions span medical imaging, breast health, and biomarker analysis, empowering earlier detection, smarter treatment decisions, and more precise outcomes across the cancer care continuum.

Lunit offers a comprehensive suite spanning risk prediction and early detection to precision oncology. Our FDA-cleared Lunit INSIGHT Breast Suite and breast health solutions support cancer screening in thousands of medical institutions worldwide, while the Lunit SCOPE platform is used in research partnership with global pharma and laboratory leaders for biomarker research, and companion diagnostic development.

Trusted by over 10,000 sites in more than 65 countries, Lunit combines deep medical expertise with continuously evolving datasets to deliver measurable impact for patients, clinicians, and researchers alike. Headquartered in Seoul with global offices, Lunit is driving the worldwide fight against cancer. Learn more at lunit.io.

About Summit Therapeutics Inc.

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of patient-, physician-, caregiver- and societal-friendly medicinal therapies intended to improve quality of life, increase potential duration of life, and resolve serious unmet medical needs.

Summit was founded in 2003 and the company’s shares are listed on the Nasdaq Global Market (symbol "SMMT"). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, with additional offices in Palo Alto, California, Princeton, New Jersey, Dublin, Ireland, and Oxford, UK.

For more information, please visit https://www.smmttx.com and follow Summit on X @SMMT_TX.

Key Terms

pd-1medical
PD-1 is a protein found on certain immune cells that acts like a brake, signaling the immune system to slow down and avoid damaging healthy tissue. Drugs that block PD-1 release that brake so immune cells can better attack cancer cells; because such therapies can produce large clinical benefits, regulatory approvals, trial outcomes, pricing and market uptake for PD-1 drugs can materially affect a drugmaker’s prospects and investor returns.
vegfmedical
Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) is a naturally occurring protein that signals the body to grow new blood vessels, like a fertilizer prompts plants to sprout. It matters to investors because drugs that block or mimic VEGF can dramatically change outcomes for cancers and eye diseases, making them major drivers of clinical trial results, regulatory approvals, market value and future revenue potential for biopharma companies.
bispecific antibodymedical
A bispecific antibody is a specially designed protein that can attach to two different targets at the same time. Think of it as a custom-made connector that brings two things together—such as a disease cell and an immune system component—helping the body fight illnesses more effectively. For investors, understanding bispecific antibodies is important because they represent innovative therapies that could lead to new treatments and potentially lucrative market opportunities.

VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / October 23, 2026 / Algo Grande Copper Corp. ("Algo Grande" or the "Company") (TSXV:ALGR)(OTCID:ALGRF)(FRA:KM00) announces that it has engaged Addison Mining Services ("Addison"), a London, UK-based geological and mining consultancy, to update the technical report prepared under National Instrument 43-101 Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects ("NI 43-101") on its 100%-owned Adelita Project in Sonora, Mexico (the "Technical Report Update").

Founded in 2014, Addison has completed more than 250 projects for over 140 clients worldwide. Its CEO and Principal Geologist, James Hogg, has more than 20 years of experience, including NI 43-101 reporting for TSX-listed companies, and acts as a Qualified Person for porphyry-related deposits, with experience in copper and in Mexico.

The current technical report has an effective date of August 15, 2025. Since acquiring Adelita in December 2025, Algo Grande has significantly advanced the project through the completion of the Phase I diamond drill program (four holes totalling 1,998 metres at Cerro Grande); a property-wide surface prospecting campaign in January 2026 (49 rock samples); the ongoing Phase II diamond drill program, which commenced in June 2026 and to date comprises approximately 4,000 metres in nine holes; UAV magnetic surveys; district-scale geological mapping; definition of the Mezquital porphyry target; a five-year surface access agreement with the Ejido Palos Chinos covering approximately 1,796 hectares, executed on September 30, 2026; and the commencement of a ground gravity survey of approximately 1,296 stations across Mezquital, Cerro Grande, Cerro Potrero and Las Trancas in October 2026. The Technical Report Update will bring the technical record up to date with this work.

Enrico Gay, CEO of Algo Grande Copper Corp., commented: "Adelita has been materially advanced in less than a year of operations, and we are proud of what our team has delivered. Updating the technical report ensures the record reflects where the project stands today."

Qualified Person Site Visit

From October 11 to 15, 2026, Mr. Hogg visited the Adelita Project with Mr. Rocha. The visit covered the Company's principal targets, including Cerro Grande, Cerro Potrero and Potrero South, Las Trancas and Mezquital. Mr. Hogg also inspected the core shack in Navojoa and field operations, and reviewed the Company's procedures for core handling and processing. The visit satisfies the personal inspection requirement under NI 43-101 for the Qualified Person responsible for the report.

The Company will file the Technical Report Update on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca upon completion.

Qualified Person

The scientific and technical information in this news release has been reviewed and approved by João Rocha, EurGeol, VP Exploration of the Company, a Qualified Person as defined by NI 43-101. Mr. Rocha is not independent of the Company.

Mr. James Hogg (MSc, BSc, MAIG), CEO and Principal Geologist of Addison, is the Qualified Person responsible for the Technical Report Update and is independent of the Company within the meaning of NI 43-101. The Technical Report Update has not yet been prepared, and no conclusions of the Qualified Person are expressed or implied by this news release.

About Algo Grande Copper Corp.

Algo Grande Copper Corp. is a mineral exploration company advancing the Adelita Project, a district-scale, multi-system copper-silver-gold opportunity positioned in the prolific Arizona-Sonora copper belt. The 5,895-hectare Adelita Project is anchored by the high-grade Cerro Grande Cu-Au-Ag skarn discovery, which exhibits strong geophysical continuity along a defined corridor extending over 7 kilometres. Reprocessing of legacy geophysical data and field mapping indicate that a potential porphyry system may occur at depth, suggesting a skarn-porphyry mineralization model comparable to deposits elsewhere in northwestern Mexico.

HUNTINGTON, W.Va., Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Energy Services of America Corporation (the "Company" or "Energy Services") (Nasdaq: ESOA) today announced that its subsidiary, FAMCO Acquisition, Inc., has completed the acquisition of substantially all of the operating assets of FAMCO, Inc. ("FAMCO"), a West Virginia utility contractor focused primarily on water and sewer infrastructure.

The acquisition was completed for a base purchase price of $6.95 million, subject to the adjustments and other terms set forth in the Asset Purchase Agreement. The consideration consists of cash and Energy Services common stock, with a portion of the purchase price withheld pending a post-closing true-up.

FAMCO brings an experienced workforce, equipment fleet and customer relationships in water and sewer infrastructure. The acquisition complements Energy Services' existing water and utility construction operations and expands its capabilities in these markets.

"We are excited to add FAMCO to the Energy Services team," said Douglas Reynolds, President of Energy Services. "FAMCO brings experienced people, equipment and customer relationships that complement our existing operations and further strengthen our capabilities in water and utility construction."

Energy Services employs 1,400+ employees on a regular basis. The Company's core values are safety, quality, and production.

PHILADELPHIA, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Board of Trustees of Aberdeen Multi-Market Income Fund (NYSE: MMT) has approved a 1-for-4 reverse stock split of the Fund's issued and outstanding common shares, effective prior to the opening of trading on November 9, 2026.

The Board approved the reverse stock split to increase the Fund's per-share market price. The Board believes a higher share price may reduce certain trading and administrative frictions associated with lower-priced securities, increase the Fund's suitability for certain investment platforms and intermediary programs, and better align the Fund's share price with industry trading conventions.

The aggregate value of a shareholder's investment is not expected to change solely as a result of the reverse stock split, although the market value of Fund shares will continue to fluctuate based on market conditions.

Under the terms of the transaction, every four common shares will be consolidated into one common share. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional share entitlements will be aggregated and sold, with the net proceeds distributed to affected shareholders. The transaction will apply equally to all shareholders and will not affect any shareholder's proportionate ownership interest, other than minor adjustments resulting from the treatment of fractional shares.

Following the transaction, the Fund's common shares will continue to trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol MMT. A new CUSIP number will be assigned to the Fund.

Transaction Details


Ticker

MMT (unchanged)

Reverse Split Ratio

1-for-4

Effective / Split-Adjusted Trading Date

November 9, 2026, prior to the opening of trading

Old CUSIP

552737108

New CUSIP

552737207

The reverse stock split will not alter the Fund's managed distribution policy. The Fund will continue to pay monthly distributions at an annualized rate equal to 11.00% of the Fund's average daily net asset value for the previous month-end prior to the declaration date. The percentage of net asset value used to determine distributions will remain unchanged following the reverse stock split. However, because fewer shares will be outstanding following the reverse stock split, the distribution paid on a per-share basis is expected to increase proportionately, while the overall distribution rate remains unchanged.

Shareholders holding shares through a brokerage account will generally have their holdings adjusted automatically. Shareholders holding physical share certificates or those with questions regarding their account should contact the Fund's transfer agent, Computershare Trust Company, N.A. Please refer to the contact details at the end of this release.

Important Information

Shares of closed-end funds are listed for trading on national securities exchanges and are bought and sold in the secondary market. The market price of a fund's shares is determined by supply and demand and may be greater than (a "premium") or less than (a "discount") the fund's net asset value (NAV). A fund's investment return and principal value will fluctuate, and investors may receive more or less than their original investment upon the sale of shares. There is no assurance that a fund will achieve its investment objective. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

The trading price of a closed-end fund's shares may be influenced by various factors, including market conditions, investor sentiment, and other external forces, and is not directly controlled by the fund, its Board of Trustees, or its investment adviser. As a result, shares may trade at a premium to or discount from NAV at any given time. A premium to NAV may not be sustained, and a discount to NAV may increase or decrease over time. Investors should consider these risks when purchasing or selling closed-end fund shares.

Shareholders whose fund shares trade at a premium to NAV and who participate in the fund's dividend reinvestment plan should be aware that distributions may be reinvested at prices above NAV, which may adversely affect investment results.

About Aberdeen Investments

Aberdeen Investments Global is the trade name of Aberdeen's investments business, herein referred to as "Aberdeen Investments" or "Aberdeen". In the United States, Aberdeen Investments refers to the following affiliated, registered investment advisers: abrdn Inc., abrdn Investments Limited, and abrdn Asia Limited.

data.description:
Proposed financing and rate measures are estimated to reduce customer impacts by $588 million over the project's 40-year life.

See more from StockTitan in Google Search and AI answers.Adds StockTitan as a preferred source · opens Google
Add on Google

The filing underscores the Monterey Peninsula's continued need for drought-proof water supplies and describes strategies to be implemented to offset project cost

PACIFIC GROVE, Calif., Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, California American Water submitted an application to the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) updating the project cost estimates, a low-cost financing framework, and a proposal for rate treatment for the Monterey Peninsula Water Supply Project's desalination facilities.

California American Water has been working with state regulatory agencies for decades to address the Monterey Peninsula's water supply crisis and lift the State Water Board's cease-and-desist order, which has limited the region's economic growth and prevented sustainable housing development. This work has reduced pumping from the Carmel River by 75 percent, to date.

In 2018, the CPUC authorized the desalination project as the best solution to address Monterey's long-term water supply needs, aligning with California's Water Resiliency Portfolio, which calls for the implementation of desalination. The CPUC approved environmental planning documents and verified supply and demand estimates that confirmed the region faces a water deficit by 2050. Subsequent to the 2018 CPUC authorization, lengthy approval and permitting processes, as well as continuous legal challenges, have extended the project timeline. These delays have exposed the project to labor and construction material cost escalations, as well as significant engineering, procurement and legal expense, resulting in a total construction estimate of $825 million.

"California American Water remains committed to ensuring the Monterey Peninsula has a reliable water supply into the future, and we are taking steps to pursue alternative sources of financing to minimize the costs and protect affordability for our customers," said California American Water President Sarah Leeper. "To mitigate the impacts of the project costs, our application proposes financing and ratemaking measures estimated to reduce the impact on customers by $588 million over the 40-year life of the project."

The California American Water team is proposing project financing and rate structures to lower the overall cost to protect Monterey's customers and protect the future of water supply on the peninsula. The company will continue working with the CPUC and state and local leaders to discuss other potential cost reductions in order to deliver a drought-proof water supply project.

California American Water and its coalition of partners, including leaders in labor, business, community and environmental advocacy, continue to view desalination as the best technical solution to diversify and drought-proof Monterey's water supplies. The CPUC filing provides new cost data, financing opportunities, and ratemaking considerations for regulators and stakeholders to evaluate and provides that the project proceeds based on sound data, appropriate funding, and clear measures to promote affordability and mitigate rate impacts.

For further updates on California American Water's work in Monterey, visit the project website www.watersupplyproject.org. 

About American Water  
American Water (NYSE: AWK) is the largest regulated water and wastewater utility company in the United States. With a history dating back to 1886 and celebrating 140 years in 2026, We Keep Life Flowing® by providing safe, clean, reliable and affordable drinking water and wastewater services to approximately 14 million people with regulated operations in 14 states and on 19 military installations. American Water's approximately 7,000 talented professionals leverage their significant expertise and the company's national size and scale to achieve excellent outcomes for the benefit of customers, employees, investors and other stakeholders.

Key Terms

master limited partnershipfinancial
A master limited partnership is a type of business structure that combines features of a corporation and a partnership, allowing it to raise money from investors while passing profits directly to them. This structure is often used by companies involved in natural resources or energy, where consistent revenue is common.
qualified noticeregulatory
A qualified notice is a formal communication that meets the specific wording, timing and delivery rules set out in a contract, corporate policy or law so it is legally effective. Think of it like a certified letter that ticks every checkbox required by an agreement. Investors care because only a qualified notice can trigger rights or changes — such as deadlines, payments, defaults or board actions — and thus can materially affect a company’s obligations and share value.
withholding agentsregulatory
A withholding agent is an entity (often an employer, broker, or payer) that is legally required to hold back and remit taxes or other required amounts from payments made to a recipient, such as wages, dividends, interest, or contractor fees. For investors, this matters because withheld amounts affect the cash they receive, determine tax reporting and potential refunds, and influence net returns in cross-border or taxable transactions — like a cashier keeping part of a payment to cover a bill.

New offering aims to reach more households at an accessible price point while maintaining Vital Farms’ commitments to animal welfare, quality and transparency.

AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) announced today the pilot launch of Vital Farms Free-Range eggs, which are expected to arrive in select Target retail stores across the South and Southeast beginning this week.

This limited test is designed to explore how Vital Farms can reach more households with a high-quality product at a more accessible suggested retail price point of less than $5 per carton, while maintaining its commitment to transparency and animal welfare.

Introducing A New Vital Farms Standard

“Free-range” is one of the most familiar terms in the egg aisle, but the standard itself doesn’t consistently tell consumers what they are actually buying. Compared with many other free-range products, the new Vital Farms Free-Range standard sets a higher bar for animal welfare in several meaningful areas: time outside, better land with living vegetation and shade, and barns designed to make it easier for hens to head outdoors. And like every carton of Vital Farms eggs, each carton can be traced back to the farm where the eggs were laid through the company’s “See The Farm” program.

This new Vital Farms standard for free-range reflects Vital Farms’ commitments to animal care, product quality, and transparency. Vital Farms loves hearing from consumers with questions. Visit vitalfarms.com/contact for details on how to call, text, direct message or write, or visit Vital Farms’ Frequently Asked Questions page to learn more.

Living Within Vital Farms’ Values and Testing Something New

“With Vital Farms Free-Range, we’re testing how we can bring more households a high-quality egg at a more accessible price point, while staying true to who we are and keeping hens’ quality of life front and center,” said Heather Mace, Vital Farms Vice President, Brand. “Our goal is to learn all we can, understand consumer appetite and grow the right way. Reaching more households gives us the opportunity to create more positive impact for our stakeholders while continuing to raise the standards in the egg aisle.”

Vital Farms Free-Range eggs are expected to be available beginning this week at select Target retail stores across the South and Southeast. For more information on where to find Vital Farms eggs, please visit: https://vitalfarms.com/where-to-buy/

ABOUT VITAL FARMS:

Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) is a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. Started on a single farm in Austin, Texas, in 2007, Vital Farms is now a national consumer brand that works with 600 small farms and is the leading U.S. brand of pasture-raised eggs by retail dollar sales. Vital Farms’ ethics are exemplified by its focus on the humane treatment of farm animals and sustainable farming practices. In addition, as a Delaware public benefit corporation, Vital Farms prioritizes the long-term benefits of each of its stakeholders, including farmers and suppliers, customers and consumers, communities and the environment, and crew members and stockholders. Vital Farms’ products, including shell eggs, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs, are sold in more than 24,000 stores nationwide. Vital Farms pasture-raised eggs can also be found on menus at hundreds of foodservice operators across the country. For more information, visit https://vitalfarms.com.

The options have an exercise price equal to the closing price of the Company's common stock on The Nasdaq Global Market on October 19, 2026, which was $3.37 per share.

One quarter of the non-qualified stock option (NQSO) will vest on the one-year anniversary of the Vesting Commencement Date. The above-described awards were granted as a material inducement to the employee’s employment and were approved by AN2’s Compensation Committee of the board of directors in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). Key Terms

restricted stock unitsfinancial
Restricted stock units are a type of company reward where employees are promised shares of stock, but they only fully own these shares after meeting certain conditions, like staying with the company for a set time. They matter because they can become valuable assets and are often used to motivate employees to help the company succeed.
non-qualified stock optionfinancial
A non-qualified stock option (NSO) is a contract that lets an employee or service provider buy company shares at a fixed price for a set period, like a voucher to purchase stock later at today’s price. It matters to investors because exercising NSOs creates ordinary income for the holder and can increase share count, affecting a company’s earnings and ownership mix; think of it as a future sale that can dilute existing shareholders and has immediate tax consequences for the recipient.
nasdaq listing rule 5635(c)(4)regulatory
NASDAQ Listing Rule 5635(c)(4) is a rule that requires a company to get approval from its shareholders before selling a large amount of its shares, usually over 20%. This helps protect investors by making sure the company doesn't flood the market with new shares without their say, which could lower the stock's value.

The $10 price is for a bundle of both Classic FICO® Score and FICO® Score 10T and is available through participating tri-merge reseller partners

BOZEMAN, Mont.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--FICO (NYSE: FICO), global analytics software leader, today announced that it will hold its wholesale mortgage price for the FICO® Score through its tri-merge resellers at $10 for lenders and brokers enrolled in its Preferred Program. The $10 price is for a bundle of both the Classic FICO® Score, the credit score that has served as the industry standard for mortgage lending for nearly three decades, and the FICO® Score 10T, FICO’s modern credit score and the most predictive credit score available to the mortgage industry.

The flat year-over-year pricing will be available to lenders who have committed to FICO through FICO’s participating tri-merge reseller partners, providing lenders access to both Classic FICO® Score and FICO® Score 10T.

“For nearly three decades, FICO has helped lenders make sound risk decisions that support the strength and stability of the U.S. mortgage system,” said Will Lansing, CEO of FICO. “By holding our price at $10 for lenders in our Preferred Program and including both Classic FICO Score and FICO Score 10T, we’re ensuring lenders have access to the trusted and predictive tools they need to assess risk with confidence. Better risk decisions strengthen the mortgage market and help lenders responsibly expand access to credit, helping more Americans achieve the dream of homeownership.”

The Classic FICO® Score has long served as the trusted foundation for credit risk assessment across the U.S. mortgage finance system, supporting its safety and soundness with a consistent, proven measure of risk. It remains the most trusted credit score across the mortgage ecosystem, used by lenders, investors, and the secondary market as a common standard for assessing borrower risk. FICO® Score 10T builds on that foundation as the most predictive credit score available to the mortgage industry, incorporating trended credit bureau data and rental payment information to provide a more precise view of a borrower’s credit risk.

For more information on the FICO® Preferred Program, please email mortgageinfo@fico.com.

For more information on how to sign up for the FICO® Score 10T Free Access Program visit the FICO Score 10T Migration Resource Center.

About FICO

FICO (NYSE: FICO) powers decisions that help people and businesses around the world prosper. Founded in 1956, the company is a pioneer in the use of predictive analytics and data science to improve operational decisions. FICO holds more than 200 U.S. and foreign patents on technologies that increase profitability, customer satisfaction and growth for businesses in financial services, insurance, telecommunications, health care, retail and many other industries. Using FICO solutions, businesses in more than 80 countries do everything from protecting 4 billion payment cards from fraud, to improving financial inclusion, to increasing supply chain resiliency. The FICO® Score, used by 90% of top U.S. lenders, is the standard measure of consumer credit risk in the U.S. and has been made available in over 40 other countries, improving risk management, credit access and transparency.
